sloka: महति स्फाटिके चित्रे रत्नसंयोगसंस्कृते ।उत्तमास्तरणास्तीर्णे सूपविष्टं वरासने ।। ५.४९.९।।।।
transliteration: mahati sphāṭike citre ratnasaṁyogasaṁskṛte ।uttamāstaraṇāstīrṇe sūpaviṣṭaṁ varāsane ।। 5.49.9।।।।

translations.english: (He was) seated on a huge magnificent throne of crystal encrusted with precious stones and overspread with a wonderful carpet.
